function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicates, with 48 patients appearing more than once (24 patients with two samples each). The data dictionary states that the row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for that patient.", "implication": "We must deduplicate on `patient_id`, keeping only the row with the highest `sample_seq` per patient. Failure to do so would double-count re-tested patients, inflating sample sizes and potentially biasing the response rate estimate if re-testing was non-random (e.g., if sicker patients were more likely to be re-tested). This is critical for the population definition in the contract."}
function.name: note_finding
